title: guatteria ouregou
intro: Guatteria ouregou, commonly known as Guatteria, is a plant species belonging to the family Annonaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Guatteria ouregou include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing pain, fever, and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Guatteria ouregou include annonaceous acetogenins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential anticancer and antimalarial activities.
